failures.title: llama-cpp CUDA kernel incompatibility with H100 NVL
failures.symptom: CUDA error: no kernel image is available for execution on the device
failures.root_cause: ghcr.io/nvidia/nemoclaw/llama-cpp-server image compiled for sm_80/86, not sm_90a
failures.maiw_impact: None — inference provider only, MAIW security boundary unaffected
failures.resolution: Resolved via workaround: H100-compatible local NIM containers (wms-nim-nano-8b on port 8002, wms-nim-teacher-49b on port 8010) were already running on the host. Selected nvidia/llama-3.1-nemotron-nano-8b-v1 via ModelGateway on host side.
failures.workaround_details: ModelGateway runs on HOST and calls localhost:8002 directly (not through OpenShell SSRF). NemoClaw llama-cpp image issue does not affect this path.

failures.title: OpenShell SSRF blocks sandbox→localhost/private NIM (expected behavior)
failures.symptom: HTTP 401/block for localhost/private IPs from inside sandbox
failures.root_cause: NemoClaw SSRF correctly blocks sandbox outbound calls to private/localhost IPs — documented behavior
failures.maiw_impact: Cannot call local NIM directly from sandbox (by design). SSRF is NOT weakened.
failures.resolution: Architecture clarified: MAIW ModelGateway runs on HOST. When a MAIW ModelGateway HTTP endpoint exists (Phase 20C), the sandbox will call that endpoint (a network-addressable, non-localhost URL that passes SSRF). The host-side ModelGateway then calls localhost:8002. This maintains SSRF protection — no code change needed.
failures.sandbox_leg_note: F02 can only be declared 'resolved architecturally' after the sandbox→sanctioned-host-endpoint path is demonstrated in a real OpenShell sandbox. That requires the Phase 20C MAIW ModelGateway HTTP endpoint.

failures.title: HF cache group-writable permission
failures.symptom: The shared Hugging Face cache is not current-user filesystem authority

failures.title: NGC API key invalid
failures.symptom: ngc config current shows Invalid apikey
failures.root_cause: NGC credentials not configured on this host
failures.maiw_impact: Cannot use NVIDIA Build API for inference
failures.resolution: Configure NGC API key from build.nvidia.com
